**Chinese name:** 北京君正集成电路股份有限公司 (Běijīng Jūnzhèng)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The closest thing China has to a global automotive/industrial memory design house — 82.7% of revenue is overseas and ISSI qualifies with world carmakers, precisely the niche US Dec-2024 rules tried to fence. Q1 2026 (latest verified): revenue ¥15.6亿 (+47.1%), net ¥3.19亿 (+331.6%) as the DRAM supercycle monetizes; FY2025 ¥47.41亿 (+12.5%). A 3D-DRAM roadmap for AI bandwidth makes it the canary for Chinese memory design moving up.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Car-grade SRAM/DRAM/NOR/eMMC, RISC/MIPS AIoT-video SoCs, automotive LED drivers and LIN/CAN transceivers.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2005 |
| **Location** | Beijing, Beijing Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Automotive/industrial memory via ISSI (¥29.11亿 of 2025 sales: SRAM world #2, niche DRAM, NOR/eMMC), MIPS/RISC-V AIoT & video SoCs, analog & car interconnect (LIN/CAN) |
| **Node Sophistication** | DRAM ramping 20nm→18nm→16nm; LPDDR5 in development; 3D DRAM targeting 2026 tape-out; SoCs ~22nm-class |
| **Entity List** | No |
